spec_match.rationale: A real product flow on RTCDTMFSender: keys append to toneBuffer per the spec's replace-semantics note, insertDTMF('') cancels, invalid characters surface the real InvalidCharacterError, and timing sliders show spec clamping.

interactive.rationale: 16-key keypad, dial string + presets, duration/gap sliders, cancel, connect/hang-up, opt-in sidetone; live connectionState/canInsertDTMF/toneBuffer and tonechange log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card describes exactly the controls and outcomes this page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Keys are disabled before connection (no init race); invalid input validated and the real exception shown; hang-up resets state; cancel verified to empty the buffer.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5160724576993280 and the relevant webrtc-pc section.

conformance.rationale: Backs the feature suite: removal (script), sender.dtmf/insertDTMF surface, video dtmf null, unnegotiated InvalidStateError, live loopback tonechange sequence and InvalidCharacterError — 7/8 pass on Chrome 153 (the removal assertion fails until M160), 8/8 with the method deleted.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153: four rapid keys queued toneBuffer '2#A' then drained to tone ''; '12x' -> InvalidCharacterError with aria-invalid=true; slider at 20 shows 'spec clamps to 40 ms'; cancel emptied buffer. Sidetone audio could not be heard headlessly. Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Every control clicked at 1280x800 and 360x740 (DPR3, touch); 0 console errors/warnings, 0 failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/shots/deprecate-and-remove-webrtc-peer-connection-method/. Also re-run with createDTMFSender deleted from the prototype by an init script to exercise the Chrome 160 removed branch.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the primary contract and on the removed/fallback branch, wrapped so telemetry can never break the page.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared dtmf-lab.css); buttons that override background also set color; emerald-dark/ink on ivory/stone; rose used only for borders/underlines, never text.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/inputs with labels, visible focus outlines, polite role=log/role=status regions, labelled focusable scroll regions for wide tables, disabled controls explained in text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800; all controls >=44px tall; wide tables scroll inside a labelled region; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Show the far-end receiving the tones
openQuestions.detail: webrtc-pc has no receive-side DTMF API, so the B side cannot show decoded tones. Consider reading inbound-rtp/codec stats on pcB for telephone-event packets to make delivery observable.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible keypad button grid with live region announcements / log live region for asynchronous event stream
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single polite live region per stream of updates (role=log); reserve assertive for critical updates; avoid announcing interstitial loading states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each async readout is one role=log aria-live=polite region (or role=status for single verdicts); fast-changing meters (toneBuffer) are aria-live=off so tone events are announced once via the log, not twice.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Adapt layouts to available space; avoid fixed widths that break narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use minmax(0,1fr) and collapse to one column under 640/720/800px; long code/errors use overflow-wrap; wide tables sit in a focusable, labelled overflow-x:auto region so the page itself measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider with visible value output label
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a labelled native input type=range; expose formatted values in DOM text and update aria-valuetext.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Duration and gap are native labelled ranges with an <output> and aria-valuetext that also states when the spec clamps the value (e.g. '20 milliseconds (spec clamps to 40 ms)').

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible keypad button grid with live region announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Sync aria-invalid with visible error state only after user interaction and link the message with aria-errormessage.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The dial-string field sets aria-invalid + aria-errormessage only on input/blur/send, naming the offending characters; the real InvalidCharacterError from insertDTMF() is also logged.

summary: Real in-page RTCPeerConnection loopback demo of the createDTMFSender() removal and its RTCRtpSender.dtmf replacement; verified headless (no DevTools MCP).
